analysis_method: Coordinator-computed saved CSV/JSON analysis; no DB, model deserialization, training or replay.

predictive_score_cohort.definition: Identical available-label union from receipt-verified selected prediction exports; not the whole generated population. No contradictory actual labels. Nonpush probability scoring.

limitations: Discovery window reused after policy/family selection; no independent performance certification.
Historical source/feature chronology remains unverified; game-line-free control does not certify all sources.
Training row-key populations and recipe match; saved artifacts do not preserve a full comparable fitting-feature matrix.
Brier/pinball/MAE evidence is conditional on available saved labels, not whole-cohort model quality.
Date-block bootstrap has 12 dates and no multiple-selection correction.
Post-hoc side/book/consensus slices are descriptive, not alternative policy replays.
No CLV or fresh paper/live validation was run.
